subject: Background screening evidence roll-up for SOC 2 request
messages:
From: ClearPath Audit <auditor@clearpath.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence request: personnel screening & training artifacts

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our routine SOC 2 scoping for Redwood, we need a consolidated package of personnel security evidence covering the last 18 months. Specifically we are looking for:

- A redacted list of background checks performed (name hashed or initials + check date + check type)
- Completed security awareness training records (employee id or initials acceptable) with completion timestamps and version of training taken
- Onboarding and offboarding logs that show account creation/deprovisioning for terminated contractors/staff
- Any formal policies that describe the background check and training cadence (policy name + last updated date)

Preferably a single ZIP with an index file (CSV) describing each document. Could you provide the package by EOD Aug 12? Also confirm whether partial PII is acceptable when redacted using SHA256 or whether you require tokenized IDs.

Thanks,
Rajesh (on behalf of ClearPath Audit)
ClearPath Audit Services
--
ClearPath Audit
contact: auditor@clearpath.com

Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request: personnel screening & training artifacts

Hi Rajesh,

Thanks — we can do that. My plan: Karthik will pull the background check metadata from HR (redacted CSV), Neha will confirm training completion exports from LMS, and I will assemble the onboarding/deprovisioning timeline and policy snapshots.

Two quick clarifying Qs:
1) Redaction: We typically provide hashed identifiers (SHA256 of email) and initials in the CSV. Is that acceptable for your audit?
2) Scope: Do you need contractor background checks that were initiated but not completed within the 18-month window?

We will target a consolidated ZIP and an index CSV by Aug 12 EOD Pacific. If you need it sooner, let us know.

Best,
Olga

Rajesh / ClearPath team,

Per your request, attached is the consolidated evidence package. Index below lists the artifacts included and the redaction approach. If you need a different redaction format, we can reissue.

Index (in-package):
- bg-check-log-redacted.csv — id_hash (SHA256 of email), initials, check_type, check_date, status
- training-completion-2026.zip — LMS export with course_id, version, completion_timestamp (employee ids hashed)
- onboarding-deprovisioning-timeline.pdf — timeline with examples of provisioning/deprovisioning events
- policies/personnel-screening-policy-2026.pdf — last updated 2026-11-05

Notes:
- We excluded contractor checks that were started but not completed within the 18-month window (per scope clarification received from client during scoping call).
- All PII removed; identifiers are hashed using SHA256 and stored in id_hash column.

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and whether the redaction/hashing meets ClearPath requirements.
- I've scheduled a 30-minute review call for Thu Aug 12 11:00 AM PT to walk through the index (invite sent separately).

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
